question: Which economic system characterized the relationship between European metropoles and their Caribbean colonies during the mercantilist era?
options: Free trade liberalism

options: Established the first British colony in the region
Produced the first Black republic in the Western Hemisphere
Ended the transatlantic slave trade immediately

options: Treaty of Utrecht
Treaty of Westphalia
Treaty of Paris
Treaty of Tordesillas

Extract forced labor from indigenous populations for Spanish colonizers

options: They held identical legal rights to white colonists

options: Jamaica gained full independence from Britain

Competition from subsidized European beet sugar production
